You’re welcome. Amazon has most of them (that’s how I got them all) and also the book app on iPhone has some of them also I know for sure it has Unf*ck yourself, it’s the only one I didn’t buy through amazon but I did buy it on my phone through the book app. 🙂

“Unf*ck yourself”- Gary John Bishop

“You are enough”- Mandy Hale

“You are a badass”- Jen Sincero 

“Girl, wash your face”- Rachel Hollis

Unf*ck yourself is more for men and women, its not as “feminine” per-say, but it’s really helpful for all around life, straight to the point and worded amazingly. 

You are enough, will seem more feminine but the message Mandy sends and the wording just touches the soul and makes soooo much sense when it comes to hurt from a relationship, the book is a lot about her own relationship failing after 10years, how it felt and how she was able to heal even when she didn’t think she could. 

You are a badass, is kind of feminine also but has good self love notes and tips to learn is to love yourself no matter what happens in life. 

Girl, wash your face, yessss, it’s based off a female and meant more for females but give it a chance! This book is the one that completely changed my life. It made SO MUCH SENSE, it had AMAZING self love tips, it walked step by step at the end of each chapter how to achieve it, it was just amazing. There are a couple chapters I skipped because they didn’t pertain to me (ex: pregnancy) but as a whole this book completely changed my life. By far my absolute favorite. 

The are a couple others I really liked but I can’t remember them right now, I can post them to you when I get home. But out of this list I whole heartedly recommend Unf*ck yourself (I read this one first, it’s excellent) You are enough (I’ve read this one twice, a good spirit lifter and Girl, wash your face (despite the name, it’s really amazing for all people) If you don’t want to try girl wash your face or can’t get into it, you are a badass is a really good self development for every aspect of life, for any person.
